description: Frontend: Feature 5 (Multilingual + Voice Explanation) — create VoiceExplainer component and integrate into PatientDashboard, GuestDashboard, and MedicalVault. This is the last feature because it adds a new reusable component that gets dropped into existing result panels already modified in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps:
STEP 1 — Create frontend/src/components/VoiceExplainer.jsx. Props: text (string), label (string, optional). State: language ('en'|'ta'|'hi'), displayText (string, starts as text prop), translating (bool), speaking (bool). Render:
  - Language selector: 3 buttons/tabs: 'EN' / 'தமிழ்' / 'हिंदी'. Active one highlighted with var(--theme-accent) border.
  - 'Listen' button with speaker icon: calls window.speechSynthesis.speak(new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(displayText)) with lang set to locale map: {en: 'en-IN', ta: 'ta-IN', hi: 'hi-IN'}[language]. If window.speechSynthesis is undefined, show 'Voice not supported in this browser.'
  - When language changes away from 'en': call POST /api/ai/explain/ with {text, language}. On response set displayText = response.data.explanation. Show loading spinner during translation. On error, keep displayText as original text.
  - When language changes back to 'en': reset displayText to original text prop immediately.
  - If speaking, show 'Stop' button that calls window.speechSynthesis.cancel().
  - Container style: background rgba(255,255,255,0.03), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), border-radius 10px, padding 12px, margin-top 12px.
  - Small disclaimer: 'Translation powered by Gemini AI. Medical values and medication names are preserved.'

STEP 2 — PatientDashboard.jsx: Import VoiceExplainer from '../../components/VoiceExplainer'. In the result panel, after the clinical_reasoning text display, add: <VoiceExplainer text={result.clinical_reasoning} label='Clinical Reasoning' />
STEP 3 — GuestDashboard.jsx: Same import and same addition in the result panel's clinical_reasoning section.

STEP 4 — MedicalVault.jsx: Import VoiceExplainer. In the pathology report expanded detail section, after parsedAnalysis.summary display, add: <VoiceExplainer text={parsedAnalysis.summary} label='Pathology Summary' />. Wrap in conditional: only show if parsedAnalysis.summary exists.
STEP 5 — Final full verification: run Django check and Vite build. Fix any remaining issues before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: Language selector shows EN / தமிழ் / हिंदी buttons
Selecting Tamil or Hindi triggers POST /api/ai/explain/ and displays translated text
Listen button triggers browser TTS with correct locale
Graceful fallback message if speechSynthesis is unsupported
VoiceExplainer added below clinical_reasoning in PatientDashboard result panel
VoiceExplainer added below clinical_reasoning in GuestDashboard result panel
VoiceExplainer added below parsedAnalysis.summary in MedicalVault expanded pathology section
verification: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check 2>&1 (expect: System check identified no issues)
cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build 2>&1 (expect: built in X.Xs with no errors)
